messages:
alex: Hey team, new hire here. Trying to finish cloud onboarding and ran into a couple blockers. Can't link billing to my GCP project and creating any resources in asia-northeast1 errors out with a policy. Also our CI needs an AWS assume-role but the SSO target is missing. Who should I ask? :wave:

marie: welcome @alex! paste the exact errors and your project number so infra can look.

alex: project number: 567890123456. GCP billing UI shows "You don't have permission to link a billing account". When I try to create a small compute instance I get:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Policy 'constraints/compute.restrictRegions' prevents this operation.
```
Also when I try to create a service account key it returns "permission denied".

devops: thanks @alex. sounds like the project landed in a folder with org policies that block SA keys and restrict regions. I'll open a ticket INFRA-12821 to move the project into onboarding-sandbox-east and link billingAccounts/2222-1111-3333. I'll also add you to roles/billing.projectManager and roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin for the project while onboarding. ETA ~1h.

infra-bot: Org policy scan for project 567890123456: constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation enforced; constraints/compute.restrictRegions limits regions to [us-central1,europe-west1]. Ticket INFRA-12821 created and assigned to devops.

alex: thanks. For AWS, terraform backend does assume-role arn:aws:iam::666777888999:role/rdw-ci but I don't see that in SSO. SSO shows no target role. CI fails with assume-role denied.

okta-bot: Please submit an SSO request with the target role arn:aws:iam::666777888999:role/rdw-ci and include your Okta email. If your Okta account is missing the `infra-dev` group, add that request in the same ticket and ops will attach it. Typical approvers: infra-approvers.

marie: @devops can you add an Okta action to INFRA-12821 to ensure `infra-dev` group membership so the SSO mapping auto-approves?

devops: done  adding Okta group step and SSO mapping. Updated INFRA-12821 with SSO placeholder REQ-80001 (please update when you submit the real SSO request).

security: quick note  region exceptions for asia will need a one-line justification if any dataset contains customer info. If it's demo/test data only, we can mark it onboarding-only and skip deeper review.

alex: only synthetic/demo data, no customer info. I'll add that to INFRA-12821. Submitted SSO request REQ-80001 and attached the SSO id to the ticket.

infra-bot: INFRA-12821 updated: project moved to onboarding-sandbox-east, billingAccounts/2222-1111-3333 linked, roles added for onboarding. Awaiting SSO approval REQ-80001 for AWS role.

alex: tested GCP actions after the move  can now create service accounts and VMs in allowed regions. Thanks for the quick help everyone. Will follow up if SSO remains pending. :pray:
